# Ecwid MCP by usefulapi MCP server

Read store products, orders, customers, categories and coupons; adjust inventory and update orders.

Category: Dev tools

● Online, checked 304 min ago · 270 ms

Source: official MCP Registry entry io.usefulapi/ecwid · [repository](https://github.com/m190/usefulapi-mcp)

## Direct MCP URL and setup

CLAUDE CODE

claude mcp add --transport http io-usefulapi-ecwid https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp

CURSOR / VS CODE (mcp.json)

{ "mcpServers": { "io-usefulapi-ecwid": { "url": "https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp" } } }
